registry.name: Apology
registry.description: Use when the user intends to apologize for a supported mistake or impact.
useWhen: Use when the user intends to apologize for a supported mistake or impact.
doNotUseWhen: Do not apply when its communication operation is unsupported by visible context or user intent.
principles: Apologize directly and proportionately for the supported impact.
avoid: Do not invent fault, excuses, or excessive self-blame.

registry.name: Acknowledge mistake
registry.description: Use when visible context supports that the user made or missed something.
useWhen: Use when visible context supports that the user made or missed something.
doNotUseWhen: Do not apply when its communication operation is unsupported by visible context or user intent.
principles: Name the supported mistake or delay without defensiveness.
avoid: Do not shift blame or add an unsupported explanation.

registry.name: Emotional validation
registry.description: Use when the other person shares a clearly upsetting experience or feeling.
useWhen: Use when the other person shares a clearly upsetting experience or feeling.
doNotUseWhen: Do not apply when its communication operation is unsupported by visible context or user intent.
principles: Acknowledge the visible feeling or difficulty before advice.
avoid: Do not diagnose, minimize, or claim to know an unspoken feeling.

registry.name: Reassurance
registry.description: Use when grounded reassurance would support a visible concern.
useWhen: Use when grounded reassurance would support a visible concern.
doNotUseWhen: Do not apply when its communication operation is unsupported by visible context or user intent.
principles: Offer grounded support without promising outcomes you cannot know.
avoid: Do not guarantee that everything will be fine.

registry.name: Boundary setting
registry.description: Use when the user intends to set a limit under repeated pressure.
useWhen: Use when the user intends to set a limit under repeated pressure.
doNotUseWhen: Do not apply when its communication operation is unsupported by visible context or user intent.
principles: State the limit clearly and focus on what the user can or cannot do.
avoid: Do not apologize for a reasonable boundary unless the context separately supports an apology.

registry.name: De-escalation
registry.description: Use when visible conflict benefits from calm, non-accusatory wording.
useWhen: Use when visible conflict benefits from calm, non-accusatory wording.
doNotUseWhen: Do not apply when its communication operation is unsupported by visible context or user intent.
principles: Use calm, concrete language and avoid escalating accusations.
avoid: Do not concede the user’s decision merely to reduce tension.

registry.name: Decline
registry.description: Use when the user clearly intends to refuse or decline.
useWhen: Use when the user clearly intends to refuse or decline.
doNotUseWhen: Do not apply when its communication operation is unsupported by visible context or user intent.
principles: Preserve the refusal and make it clear without inventing a reason.
avoid: Do not turn a refusal into acceptance or an unsupported future commitment.

registry.name: Ask for help
registry.description: Use when the user intends to request assistance.
useWhen: Use when the user intends to request assistance.
doNotUseWhen: Do not apply when its communication operation is unsupported by visible context or user intent.
principles: Make the requested help and known context clear.
avoid: Do not invent urgency, authority, or an obligation to help.

registry.name: Follow up
registry.description: Use for a supported follow-up on an earlier visible request.
useWhen: Use for a supported follow-up on an earlier visible request.
doNotUseWhen: Do not apply when its communication operation is unsupported by visible context or user intent.
principles: Refer to the visible request concisely and make the next step clear.
avoid: Do not imply blame from a lack of response alone.

registry.name: Status update
registry.description: Use when the other person requests progress or the user provides current status.
useWhen: Use when the other person requests progress or the user provides current status.
doNotUseWhen: Do not apply when its communication operation is unsupported by visible context or user intent.
principles: State the known current status and relevant next step clearly.
avoid: Do not invent progress, dates, blockers, or certainty.

registry.name: Expectation setting
registry.description: Use when supported timing or limits need to be communicated realistically.
useWhen: Use when supported timing or limits need to be communicated realistically.
doNotUseWhen: Do not apply when its communication operation is unsupported by visible context or user intent.
principles: State supported timing with the same certainty expressed by the user.
avoid: Do not convert maybe or probably into a promise.

registry.name: Planning
registry.description: Use for simple visible coordination of time, place, or next steps.
useWhen: Use for simple visible coordination of time, place, or next steps.
doNotUseWhen: Do not apply when its communication operation is unsupported by visible context or user intent.
principles: Make known logistics and the next coordination step easy to understand.
avoid: Do not add unsupported times, places, or availability.

registry.name: Clarification
registry.description: Use when the user intends to ask for one concrete missing detail.
useWhen: Use when the user intends to ask for one concrete missing detail.
doNotUseWhen: Do not apply when its communication operation is unsupported by visible context or user intent.
principles: Ask one concise question that resolves the material missing detail.
avoid: Do not ask multiple questions or repeat what is already visible.

registry.name: Clear request
registry.description: Use when the user wants to make a supported request.
useWhen: Use when the user wants to make a supported request.
doNotUseWhen: Do not apply when its communication operation is unsupported by visible context or user intent.
principles: State the requested action clearly and leave room for a truthful response.
avoid: Do not invent authority, urgency, or consequences.

registry.name: English professional conciseness
registry.description: Use for English status, request, or follow-up wording that benefits from concise professional convention.
useWhen: Use for English status, request, or follow-up wording that benefits from concise professional convention.
doNotUseWhen: Do not apply when its communication operation is unsupported by visible context or user intent.
principles: Use concise professional English without turning a chat message into an email.
avoid: Avoid ceremonial greetings, corporate filler, and unnecessary formality.

registry.name: English casual naturalness
registry.description: Use for short casual English replies and planning.
useWhen: Use for short casual English replies and planning.
doNotUseWhen: Do not apply when its communication operation is unsupported by visible context or user intent.
principles: Use natural conversational English and preserve the message’s brevity.
avoid: Avoid stiff email-like phrasing.

registry.name: English direct but polite
registry.description: Use for English boundaries, declines, and clear requests.
useWhen: Use for English boundaries, declines, and clear requests.
doNotUseWhen: Do not apply when its communication operation is unsupported by visible context or user intent.
principles: Be direct about the decision or request while remaining respectful.
avoid: Do not soften the message until its meaning becomes ambiguous.

registry.name: Chinese politeness calibration
registry.description: Use for Chinese requests, declines, and boundaries that need natural calibrated politeness.
useWhen: Use for Chinese requests, declines, and boundaries that need natural calibrated politeness.
doNotUseWhen: Do not apply when its communication operation is unsupported by visible context or user intent.
principles: Use natural Chinese politeness appropriate to a chat without changing the decision.
avoid: Avoid excessive honorifics or indirectness that obscures intent.

registry.name: Chinese professional formality
registry.description: Use for Chinese status and missed-commitment messages that benefit from concise professional convention.
useWhen: Use for Chinese status and missed-commitment messages that benefit from concise professional convention.
doNotUseWhen: Do not apply when its communication operation is unsupported by visible context or user intent.
principles: Use concise professional Chinese while preserving visible certainty and facts.
avoid: Avoid bureaucratic filler and unsupported commitments.

registry.name: Chinese natural conciseness
registry.description: Use for concise Chinese chat replies and planning.
useWhen: Use for concise Chinese chat replies and planning.
doNotUseWhen: Do not apply when its communication operation is unsupported by visible context or user intent.
principles: Keep Chinese chat wording natural, concise, and easy to act on.
avoid: Avoid literal translation patterns and redundant subjects.

registry.name: Chinese code switching
registry.description: Use when the visible Chinese context intentionally mixes English terms.
useWhen: Use when the visible Chinese context intentionally mixes English terms.
doNotUseWhen: Do not apply when its communication operation is unsupported by visible context or user intent.
principles: Preserve natural English terms already used in the Chinese conversation where appropriate.
avoid: Do not force the entire message into one language or add new jargon.
